notesStmt.note: This manuscript likely dates from 1884 or 1885.

A manuscript containing draft titles for "You Tides with Ceaseless Swell," first published along with seven other poems in The Nineteenth Century (August 1885), under the general title "Fancies at Navesink." The poem was later included in November Boughs (1888).
